# llms.txt

## Site purpose
DolphinsINTuition is a research and content platform exploring human-dolphin communication using AI. We publish peer-reviewed analysis of cetacean cognition, bioacoustics, and interspecies communication research, alongside character-driven educational content about dolphin intelligence.

## About this site
- **Project URL**: https://dolphinsintuition.com
- **Contact**: DolphinsIntuition@gmail.com
- **Mission**: Advance credible, scientifically grounded understanding of dolphin intelligence and explore the possibility of meaningful interspecies communication.

## Key content areas
- **Research Briefs**: Compute-only analysis of dolphin acoustics, cognition, and AI applications
- **Finn & Echo**: Educational video series with AI-generated dolphin characters explaining cetacean science
- **Data & Knowledge Hub**: Published analysis, literature reviews, and research methodology

## Recommended reading entry points
- Research Brief Archive: https://dolphinsintuition.com/research
- Finn & Echo Episode Guide: https://dolphinsintuition.com/characters
- Cognitive Research Index: https://dolphinsintuition.com/knowledge

## Content policy
All research content is grounded in published cetacean science and reflects current understanding. We distinguish clearly between established science and speculative frontier research. No animal welfare-sensitive fieldwork is discussed without ethical review.

## AI & ML applications mentioned
- Transformer-based acoustic analysis (CETI project, sperm whale codas)
- Contrastive learning on dolphin vocalizations (Dolph2Vec)
- Fine-tuned language models for interspecies communication research (DolphinGemma)
- Real-time signal classification and playback systems

## Latest research briefs
- DIC-7527: Sperm Whale Coda Architecture & Machine Learning Applications
- DIC-7248: Mirror Self-Recognition in Cetaceans & Cognitive Implications
- DIC-7115/7116: Dolph2Vec: Representation Learning on Dolphin Whistles
